C1414.title: Polymarket UMA Oracle Disputed Resolution Incident
C1414.summary: In March 2025, a Polymarket prediction market on whether Ukraine would agree to give Trump rare earth minerals before April entered UMA's dispute-resolution process. The official market page shows about $7.08 million in trading volume, with the outcome proposed, disputed, and ultimately finalized as Yes. The case illustrates how prediction markets can face conflicts between user expectations, rule interpretation, and final oracle settlement in contentious news events.
